content.text: No non-solicitation or no-hire covenant exists anywhere in the Agreement, and § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer is unrestricted.

input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Targeted searches for "solicit", "recruit", "hire", "induce", "employ", "poach" and "non-solicitation" across the whole Agreement (including General (§ 30), Customer Responsibilities (§ 12) and Confidentiality (§ 16)) return no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding either Party. To the contrary, § 12.3 expressly confirms that nothing restricts Customer from hiring any person who responds to general recruitment and that Customer has made no no-hire commitment. This meets our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is needed; note that § 12.4 restricts Vendor only and benefits us.
